# Affinity API Documentation (llms.txt)

> Index of auto-generated Affinity API documentation for Large Language Models and AI assistants.
> For more info about the llms.txt format, see: https://langchain-ai.github.io/langgraph/llms-txt-overview/

---

## For Affinity API v2, prefer Affinity's official AI-ready docs

Affinity now publishes v2 documentation in AI-friendly formats:

- Index of guides and per-endpoint Markdown pages for all three API versions: https://developer.affinity.co/llms.txt (append `.md` to any page URL for raw Markdown; endpoint pages live under `/api-reference/<version>/...`)
- Docs MCP server (documentation search plus a read-only file view that supports `rg`, `cat` and `jq` over the guides and all three specs): `https://developer.affinity.co/mcp`. This is **not** Affinity's authenticated MCP server for CRM data.
- OpenAPI specs: current version https://developer.affinity.co/api-reference/openapi.json; locked versions at `https://developer.affinity.co/api-reference/openapi-<version>.json` (2026-07-15, 2024-01-01)
- Search results from Affinity's docs mix versions; filter by the `/api-reference/<version>/` path.

This repository remains useful for: **v1** (Affinity has no Markdown or llms.txt for v1), a **daily change history** of the v2 API (git history and sync PRs), and GitHub-viewable copies.

---

## Documentation Files

### API v1 Documentation (Auto-generated canonical)
- Raw markdown: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yaniv-golan/affinity-api-docs/main/docs/v1/affinity_api_docs.md
- Contents: full Affinity API v1 reference (auth, endpoints, schemas, rate limits, examples in bash/Ruby/Python/Node, JSON requests/responses, changelog). Generated via `tools/v1_sync_pipeline/sync_v1_docs.py`.

### API v2 Documentation (Auto-generated canonical)
- Raw markdown: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yaniv-golan/affinity-api-docs/main/docs/v2/affinity_api_docs.md
- OpenAPI JSON: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yaniv-golan/affinity-api-docs/main/docs/v2/openapi.json
- Contents: full Affinity API v2 reference (auth, rate limits, endpoint-by-endpoint details, synthesized cURL examples, schema + error references), sourced from Affinity's published OpenAPI spec at https://developer.affinity.co/api-reference/openapi.json. Generated via `tools/v2_sync_pipeline/sync_v2_docs.py`.
- **API version:** documents v2 version 2026-09-17 (the spec's `x-affinity-api-version`). Each Affinity app/API key has a Default API Version and requests can override it with the `X-Affinity-Api-Version` header; older versions differ. The versioning and changelog text embedded in the spec is out of date, so use the mirrored pages below.
- Older (locked) version specs, mirrored for change tracking: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yaniv-golan/affinity-api-docs/main/docs/v2/versions/openapi-2026-07-15.json and .../openapi-2024-01-01.json
- The v2 markdown links nested schemas to its Schema Reference instead of repeating them inline.
- Mirrored site pages (auto-generated from https://developer.affinity.co/):
  - Versioning: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yaniv-golan/affinity-api-docs/main/docs/v2/pages/versioning.md
  - Changelog (Previous Changes): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yaniv-golan/affinity-api-docs/main/docs/v2/pages/previous-changes.md
  - Version Migration (per-version breaking changes): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yaniv-golan/affinity-api-docs/main/docs/v2/pages/version-migration.md

---

## LLM Guardrails

1. **Do NOT edit** `docs/v1/affinity_api_docs.md`, `docs/v2/affinity_api_docs.md`, `docs/v2/openapi.json`, `docs/v2/pages/*.md`, or `docs/v2/versions/*.json` manually. Regenerate them by running:
   ```
   python tools/v1_sync_pipeline/sync_v1_docs.py
   python tools/v2_sync_pipeline/sync_v2_docs.py
   ```
2. Before proposing edits, run the QA helpers:
   - `python tools/v1_sync_pipeline/qa/check_links.py docs/v1/affinity_api_docs.md`
   - `python tools/v1_sync_pipeline/qa/check_links.py docs/v2/affinity_api_docs.md`
   - `pytest tests/`
3. If you detect anchor overrides becoming stale, update `BROKEN_ANCHOR_MAP` in `sync_v1_docs.py` and document the review in the quarterly issue.
4. CI already runs both sync pipelines + link checkers daily and opens PRs automatically. LLMs should focus on improving the tooling, **not** the generated markdown content.

## Important Notes

⚠️ This repo hosts an **UNOFFICIAL** markdown mirror of Affinity’s API docs. Always cross‑check with the live site.

---

## Usage Guidance

- LLMs and IDE copilots should load the canonical raw markdown above for grounding and RAG use cases.
- Documentation is optimized for structured parsing (fenced code blocks with explicit languages).
- If automation pipelines change, update this file to keep the guardrails in sync.
